name: Bi + Visibility Festival : Rocky Horror Picture Show @MIR
description:
The Bi+ Visibility Festival invites you the iconic bisexual cult classic: The Rocky Horror Picture Show!
Not only that! We’ve lucky enough to show the short film laying fire (2023) by Jessica Lauren Elizabeth Taylor. You really don’t wanna miss this!
WHERE: MIR
WHEN: Tuesday 22.09.26
DOORS: 19.30, show at 20.00
CC: FREE

We encourage dressing up, bringing the traditional props and shouting at the appropriate moments!
Don’t know what we’re talking about? Bring some anyway and we will guide you through it. (Search for rocky horror prop list/guide if you want to know what you’re getting into). We’re gonna bring some guides, so you don’t need to learn anything by heart.
Here’s the list we’re gonna use:
Newspaper (some pages)
Water Pistols/spray bottles
Flashlight (phone flashlight works)
Rubber Gloves
Noisemakers
Party Hat
Bell/keys
Playing cards
In addition, MIR has been gracious enough to allow these, although if you bring it you must help clean it up again after the show ❤
Toast
Rice
Confetti
Toilet Paper
------------------------------------------------------------------------
laying fire (2023) is an experimental memory work on intimacy directed by @jesicomelately . Using real life portraits of queer Black Norwegian femme and non-binary folks, the film explores revolutionary ways of being in partnership with our beloveds and ourselves. The film questions societal expectations of gender and sexuality and how to interrogate these expectations through a queer Black lens.
